doctrine: a missing evidence artifact blocks QC only when (1) it has a legitimate producer, (2) the run has reached the point where it should exist, and (3) the run's production mode actually requires that semantic evidence

fail_closed_rules: required kind with no policy row -> QC_EVIDENCE_POLICY_VIOLATION
mode-sensitive kind without declared mode -> QC_PRODUCTION_MODE_REQUIRED
required kind before earliest legitimate gate -> NOT_APPLICABLE_YET (never a missing blocker)
tasks without run_mode keep exact legacy semantics
